usedFor: Todoist holds the task list, and Contentful receives content ideas when “New Task Created in Project” runs “Create Entry”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Entry” in Contentful
bestTemplate.why: A task in a content project becomes an entry, so drafting starts in Contentful without retyping.

watchOut: “Publish Entry” makes an entry available to the Content Delivery API, so keep it behind a review step.
